newsitem.title: GERMANY: Photographer fined for nude church snaps.
newsitem.headline: Photographer fined for nude church snaps.

text.p: A photographer who hired two models to pose naked except for "Adam and Eve"-style fig leaves in Cologne cathedral was fined and given a suspended jail sentence on Monday.

A Cologne court ruled the photographer had disturbed religious practice, maliciously reviled the church and committed trespass with his actions in July last year. It rejected his defence that he been creating a work of art.
The court ordered the photographer to pay 3,000 marks and gave him a suspended prison sentence of four months.
